title: P2 frozen-base LoRA numerical contract
hypothesis: A frozen T0 base with an exact LoRA tensor manifest can preserve the v0.1 summed-loss worker contract and produce an adapter-only coordinator update identical to an independent mean-loss reference while leaving every base tensor unchanged.

use_case.claim: Establish a reproducible numerical foundation for later volunteer PEFT campaigns before adding browser, native, retry, or offload behavior.

baseline.label: Independent dense-reference update
baseline.description: A separately initialized frozen-base LoRA model performs direct mean-loss backward, one global-norm clip, and AdamW on the exact adapter tensor set.

primary_metric.label: Exact adapter update match
primary_metric.description: Ratio of required adapter tensors byte-equal to the independent reference after one optimizer step.

repeated_validation_suite.label: PEFT targeted regression suite
repeated_validation_suite.description: Checks base freezing, complete deterministic gradients, exact update parity, manifest validation, deterministic export, and CLI execution.

final_holdout_suite.label: Real command-line artifact proof
final_holdout_suite.description: Two independent command-line exports must be byte-identical and every portable checksum must verify through sha256sum.

guardrails.label: Frozen base remains unchanged
guardrails.description: No base parameter changes during the submitted-gradient or independent-reference update.

guardrails.label: Complete adapter gradient set
guardrails.description: Every and only manifest-declared adapter tensor has a finite FP32 gradient.

guardrails.label: Stable dense baseline remains green
guardrails.description: The complete repository regression suite passes without changing the shipped dense campaign path.

independent_variables.label: Trainable tensor set
independent_variables.description: Four combined attention-QKV LoRA pairs replace full dense trainability.

controlled_variables.label: T0 base and deterministic batch
controlled_variables.description: The exact existing T0 architecture, initialization, token batch, loss reduction, optimizer hyperparameters, and clipping threshold remain fixed.
